name: @henlii/dsh-web-mobile
description: DSH plugin: phone chrome for the shipped dsh web shell. The left and right columns become overlay drawers (no permanent rail), Settings becomes a two-level page stack, the chat gets phone spacing, and the layout tracks the visible viewport height (document overflow and keyboard). Also ships an optional phone-entry reverse proxy: it listens on one LAN/tailnet address, rewrites Host/Origin to the upstream loopback authority and forwards HTTP + WebSocket, so the phone page gets host-scope settings instead of being treated as a remote viewer.
deprecated: Merged into @henlii/dsh-web-auth 0.6.0 (mobile layout + phone-entry proxy). No further releases.
